title: 交易心理 | 慢慢变富：复利在币圈的真正样子
subTitle:

算笔账：每天只赚1%，一年250个交易日下来是12倍；每月稳定10%，
三年下来30倍。听着不刺激，但它有个神奇之处——它不依赖运气。

后者的能力是你的。市场天天开门，留住本金的人才有资格一直玩。

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | Getting Rich Slowly: What Compounding Really Looks Like in Crypto
translatedData.subTitle:
Everyone wants to double their money overnight, but the people who truly hold on to their gains in this market are the ones who “get rich slowly.”
Let’s do the math: earn just 1% a day, and after 250 trading days in a year, you’ll have 12 times your starting amount. Earn a steady 10% a month,
and you’ll have 30 times your starting amount after three years. It may not sound thrilling, but it has one remarkable advantage—it doesn’t depend on luck.

Doubling your money depends on market conditions; compounding depends on discipline. You wait for the market; discipline is yours. Don’t set your goal
as “double your money this week.” Make it “no major mistakes this week.” The money from the first goal comes from the market,
while the ability behind the second is yours. The market is open every day, but only those who preserve their capital can keep playing.

content:
以太坊市场深度分析：ETF利好消化中，短期面临方向选择

一、价格走势分析

截至二零二六年十月十二日上午，以太坊报价两千五百五十八美元，过去二十四小时上涨百分之二点三六。价格在亚盘时段触及两千五百七十九点八八美元的日内高点后回落，目前在两千五百五十至两千五百六十美元区间窄幅整理。从小时K线来看，最近五根K线呈现冲高回落的格局，成交量在冲高时段放大至五千九百万美元级别，随后逐步萎缩至六百九十万美元，显示追涨动能有所衰减。

均线系统方面，七日均线两千五百六十美元与当前价格基本持平，二十五日均线两千五百四十一美元和九十九日均线两千五百零七美元仍然保持多头排列，说明中长期趋势尚未破坏。布林带上轨两千五百七十二美元，中轨两千五百四十八美元，下轨两千五百二十四美元，价格在中轨上方运行，整体处于中性偏强格局。

二、技术指标解读

RSI指标显示市场处于中性区域。RSI六周期为四十七点一九，RSI十二周期为五十五点四七，RSI二十四周期为五十七点三九，三线均处于五十附近，说明多空力量相对均衡。KDJ指标中K值四十四点九八，D值五十七点一二，J值二十点七二，K线向下穿越D线形成死叉信号，短期动能偏弱。威廉指标负五十二点一八，处于中性区域。随机RSI指标十点一五，接近超卖区域。

MACD方面，快线十一点零八与慢线十一点八七非常接近，柱状图刚刚转负为零点七九，显示多头动能正在减弱。值得注意的是，此前六小时RSI一度突破八十进入超买区域，随后快速回落，说明短期获利盘有较明显的兑现意愿。综合技术因子来看，十五个因子中八个做多、六个做空、一个中性，做多比例百分之五十三点三三，但综合指标数值为零，发出做空信号，历史胜率百分之七十点二一，表明当前处于方向选择的关键时刻。

三、市场情绪分析

以太坊市场面临的情绪面较为复杂。利好方面，泰国SEC批准现货以太坊ETF将于十月十六日上线，为区域市场注入信心。此前大单净流入一度达到四千九百六十万美元，推动价格突破两千五百七十美元阻力位。此外，Solana生态占据全球代币化股票交易量的百分之六十五，香港Solana ETF即将上线，整个加密生态的机构化进程持续推进。

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | What Usually Happens When You FOMO Into a Candlestick
translatedData.subTitle:
The coin’s price shoots up in a big bullish candle, everyone in the group chat is shouting “Let’s go!”, and you nervously chase in—only to end up
buying at the top. This scenario plays out every day.

Take a close look at that big bullish candle that makes your heart race: it’s what people who are already fully invested hope you’ll chase so they can sell
After a sharp surge on heavy volume, chasing the price is essentially providing liquidity for those who bought earlier.

A simple but effective trick: when you feel like chasing, force yourself to wait for three candlesticks. If the pullback comes on lower volume and the price stabilizes,
you’ll get a better entry; if it drops straight back down, congratulations—you’ve saved yourself an expensive lesson. The market will always
give you a second chance, but it won’t give you your capital back a second time.

【ETH at $ 2555: A 48% Plunge—What Are Long-Term Investors Watching?】

Last week, an old friend asked me: "Is now a good time to buy ETH?"

I didn't answer right away.

Seeing me hesitate, he added: "It's already down almost half. Isn't it time to buy the dip?"

Honestly, that's not an easy question to answer. Not because I know where the market is headed—nobody does. It's because the question "Is now a good time to buy?" is far too simplistic.

What are you hoping to buy into? A short-term bounce, or a bet that it will hit new highs over the next two years?

Those are completely different theses.

$ 2555 is just a step away from the key support below at $ 2448, with resistance overhead at $ 2627. The sentiment index is 69, and the weekly chart is still down nearly 6 points.

But today, I don't want to talk about technicals.

Who does a 48% drawdown matter to?

Institutional players have been quietly building positions in this range for a while. Liquidity has recovered since last October, and big players' order books are deeper than they were back then. So who's really been shaken out? Leveraged gamblers, newcomers who chased in near the highs, and people who kept shouting "ETH will hit 10,000" but had no position.

This isn't a value trap. It's an opportunity for big money to reprice the market.

For long-term investors, a 48% drawdown means they can accumulate at lower prices. That's what's really interesting about this level—not "Will it keep falling?" but "Who's buying and who's selling?"

Ordinary retail investors are in the toughest spot right now: they're afraid of getting trapped if they buy, but reluctant to sell at a loss. What about big money? What I've observed is that some are building positions in ETF-related plays in stages, some are buying spot on the dip, and others are waiting for futures premiums to recover. Those are the signals that are really worth watching.

ETH being down 48% isn't the end of the world. For some, it's actually an opportunity. The key is to understand which side you're on.

My view: a wait-and-see signal makes more sense. I'm not bearish; I'm waiting for the market to give us a clearer answer.

$ 2448 is the lifeline; $ 2627 is the short-term hurdle. If it holds, I'll keep watching. If it breaks, I'll reassess.

Which way is your signal pointing?

content:
【$ 2555的ETH：48%的深坑，长线资金在看的什么？】

上周有个老朋友问我："ETH现在能不能买？"

我没直接回答。

他见我犹豫，自己补了一句："都跌了快一半了，是不是该抄底了？"

说实话，这个问题不好回答。不是因为我不知道行情怎么走——谁都不知道。而是因为"能不能买"这个问题本身就很粗暴。

你想抄的是什么？是短线反弹，还是赌未来两年能创新高？

这两个逻辑完全不同。

$ 2555，离下方关键支撑$ 2448就一步之遥，上面压制在$ 2627。情绪指数69，周线还跌了将近6个点。

但今天我不想聊技术面。

48%的回撤，对谁有意义？

机构级玩家早就在这个区间慢慢建仓了。去年10月之后流动性已经重新恢复，大玩家的订单深度比那时候还强。真正被甩下车的是谁？杠杆赌徒、高位追进来的新韭菜、还有那些喊着"ETH会到一万"但没仓位的人。

这不是价值陷阱，这是大资金重新定价的机会。

对长线资金来说，48%的回撤意味着可以用更低的价格积累。这才是这个位置真正有意思的地方——不是"还会不会跌"，而是"谁在买谁在卖"。

普通散户现在最难受：追进去怕被套，割肉又舍不得。大资金呢？我观察到的是，分批建仓ETF概念的、趁低吸纳现货的、等期货溢价修复的——这些才是真正有意思的信号。

ETH跌了48%不是世界末日。对某些人来说，这反而是机会。关键是看清楚自己站在哪边。

我的判断：观望信号更合理。不是看空，是等市场给我们一个更明确的答案。

$ 2448是生命线，$ 2627是短期门槛。守住，我就继续盯着。跌破，再看。

你的信号方向是？

Why is it difficult for public blockchains to achieve speed, security, and decentralization all at once?
A Layer 1 network is a blockchain that handles its own consensus and settlement, such as Bitcoin, Ethereum, and Solana.
The more validator nodes there are, the more messages need to be exchanged to reach consensus, making it harder to improve performance. This is why these three factors constrain one another.
$ETH  is the native token of Ethereum, a Layer 1 public blockchain, and is used to pay gas fees and for staking.

验证节点越多，达成共识需要交换的消息就越多，性能也越难提上去，这就是三者彼此牵制的原因。

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | When You Hold a Losing Position, Your Brain Is Deceiving You
translatedData.subTitle:
What does someone down 50% on a position look at? The all-time high. They tell themselves, “If it gets back to my entry price,
I’ll get out.” But notice: this thought is pure attachment, with no logic behind it. The market doesn’t know your entry price;
it only responds to current supply and demand.

Once you decide to hold a losing position, you automatically seek out good news and filter out bad news. This is called confirmation bias. You start thinking,
“This time is different.” Those five words have burned more money throughout history than any hacker ever has.

The antidote is simple, but hard to put into practice: before opening a position, write down “Under what circumstances would the logic behind this trade
no longer hold?” Then act when the time comes, regardless of how you feel. By separating the decision from the act of holding, you can see things clearly.

Bitcoin’s price action over the past couple of days has been testing our patience. After briefly dipping below 80,000 and recovering, it ran into resistance near 85,000 and has continued to move sideways within a narrow range.

On the weekly chart, we have a moderately bearish candle down 3%, erasing the previous small bullish candle. However, it also has a long lower wick, suggesting that gains may be hard to come by this week, while buyers are stepping in to support the price on dips. A smooth decline is unlikely either, so the most likely scenario is continued weak, range-bound trading.

On the daily chart, the price is currently meeting resistance near 85,000 at the breakdown trendline we’ve been watching closely. Whether it can reclaim and hold this level will determine what happens next. If it gets back above and holds, it could revisit the previous high or even set a new one. If it continues to fail to break through, the market will weaken and move lower.

Looking at the monthly Bollinger Bands, the price has been capped by the middle band at 87268 for two consecutive months. As the dividing line between strength and weakness in the broader trend, this level won’t be easy to break decisively. It will take repeated attempts and sustained accumulation of trading volume—which is exactly why we characterize this as the early stage of a bull market!

Overall, resistance near 85000 remains significant for now, and the most likely scenario is a rejection followed by a move down to look for support.

That said, the downside may be limited. First, watch 82100, followed by the Fibonacci 0.236 level at 80400. This level has already held during a previous decline, so near-term support looks fairly solid.【❤️As shown in Figure 1】

For now, it’s best to watch more and trade less. The price action ahead may be more complex than expected, so it’s safer to wait until the direction becomes relatively clear before making a decision!

Trading plan: I’ve now fully replenished my Binance community spot position near the lows, around 82000. I’m currently heavily invested in spot, so I’ll simply hold.【❤️As shown in Figure 2】

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | A Stop Loss Isn’t an Admission of Being Wrong—it’s a Ticket to the Next Opportunity
translatedData.subTitle:
Many people can’t bring themselves to set a stop loss because they treat it as proof that “I was wrong,” and their pride
gets in the way. Try looking at it this way: a stop loss is insurance you bought in advance, and the premium is that small loss.
The difference between a professional trader and a gambler isn’t who’s more accurate, but who allows themselves to be wrong.

The steadiest traders I’ve ever seen cut their losses more decisively than anyone when they’re wrong. Because they know: whether this trade is right or wrong
doesn’t matter. What matters is the expected value over a hundred trades. The next time your hand trembles as you go to stop out, tell yourself:
This is an admission ticket, not a verdict.

Ethereum ETF Outflows: Should ETH Investors Be Concerned? 📉
When investment funds experience repeated outflows, it's natural to ask whether investor demand is weakening.
Recent reporting has highlighted a prolonged period of outflows from Ether ETFs, making fund-flow data an important part of the Ethereum market discussion. �
The Block
But outflows deserve analysis, not automatic panic.
Here's how I'd approach the situation:
1. Look at the duration.
One negative session is different from a sustained pattern.
2. Compare the wider market.
Are other crypto assets experiencing similar pressure?
3. Watch the price response.
Is ETH holding up despite outflows, or is selling pressure increasing?
4. Separate fund flows from network fundamentals.
ETF activity and Ethereum's actual network usage measure different things.
These indicators can influence one another, but they aren't interchangeable.
A period of outflows may signal weaker demand from a particular investor group. It doesn't, by itself, prove that Ethereum's long-term prospects have changed.
I'd rather assess several indicators together than make a decision based on one headline.
Your view: Are Ethereum ETF outflows a temporary market phase or a warning sign that deserves closer attention?

Let’s talk about public blockchains and the blockchain trilemma.
A Layer 1 is a blockchain that handles its own consensus and settlement, such as Bitcoin, Ethereum, and Solana.
To be honest, this is something I only understood later: when transferring between different public blockchains, make sure the networks match. The same token on different chains usually has a separate contract on each chain.
$ETH  is the native coin of Ethereum, a Layer 1 public blockchain, and is used to pay gas fees and for staking.
The market is always uncertain, so decide in advance what you’ll do if your judgment turns out to be wrong.

📰 Why Is Standard Chartered Helping XRP with RLUSD Custody? What’s Behind the LMAX Collateral Plan?

UK banking giant Standard Chartered is trying something new: helping Ripple manage its RLUSD stablecoin, while also looking to use the token as collateral. This adds a new chapter to the stablecoin and institutional finance story, but it has little direct connection to BTC or ETH—it’s simply an expansion of business within the crypto industry.

Why does this news matter?
Standard Chartered isn’t just dabbling. As one of the world’s largest banks, its decision to custody RLUSD signals confidence in Ripple’s technology stack. After all, the XRP Ledger ecosystem is a distinctive presence in the stablecoin world. And Standard Chartered’s interest in the LMAX collateral program is even more intriguing: institutions need margin to trade crypto, and RLUSD is becoming a new option, helping promote the use of stablecoins as collateral. Behind this is institutional capital looking to enter crypto while wary of volatility—with stablecoins serving as a bridge.

Market impact
There’s little direct short-term impact on BTC and ETH, but in the long run, wider adoption of stablecoins as collateral could lower the barrier to entry for institutions and diversify capital flows. For example, with markets currently highly volatile, Standard Chartered’s move could attract more risk-averse capital, benefiting exchanges like LMAX as well as the broader DeFi collateral ecosystem. Historically, when major traditional financial institutions enter a sector, it often signals that the space is about to become more regulated and scale up.

How to approach it
💡 Standard Chartered’s move suggests the stablecoin sector is set to become more diverse, and RLUSD may attract institutional clients. But in the short term, BTC and ETH will still depend on their fundamentals. If LMAX starts using RLUSD as collateral at scale over the next few months, and the market avoids panic selling, this model could help stabilize other stablecoins too. This thesis would be invalidated if institutions find RLUSD too costly or regulatory risks emerge.

From #ETH 20 to 58 million: the dumb way is the real cash machine.

A few years ago, I met a veteran in the crypto scene. He entered with 200,000 and grew it to 58 million. One sentence he said has stayed with me ever since: “The crypto market is all about emotional sheep. If you can control yourself, the market is your wallet!”

Following him around for years, I summarized 4 ironclad money-making rules. Newbies who do this can cut losses by 80%:

1. Don’t make small money, don’t lose big money
These 8 words have ruined countless people! Open a 20,000 position, it rises 5% and you run; then you miss 50%. Next time you get greedy and want more, it rises and you don’t take profit, then it falls back to your principal and you stop out. Remember: don’t mess around with small fluctuations, get out first when the risk is big.

2. Only buy “major coins that have already been beaten down”
Don’t touch flashy new coins at all! Only pick major coins that have fallen to the bottom and stabilized. Start by putting in 10% of your position as a base. Don’t try to guess the bottom; wait until it stands firm before acting. It may be dumb, but it won’t make you step on a zeroing-out landmine.

3. Add to your position only after the trend is steady
Don’t copy others and blindly buy the dip! Wait until it’s confirmed to be moving up, then add another 20%-30% on pullbacks. Even if the price is a bit higher, that’s still better than being trapped halfway up the mountain and crying. Trend matters 100 times more than entry price.

4. Once it rises, “recover principal and lock in profit”
Every time it goes up a wave, first take out your principal plus half the profit! Let the rest be tossed around by the market; money already in your pocket is the real money. Last year I used this trick to help a brother who had lost over 600,000. He broke even in six months and even made enough to buy a BMW X5.

Low options volatility usually occurs when markets are calm and demand for protection is rising. This time, it isn’t due to worsening news; it’s related to the first drop in miner hashrate in the past two weeks and concerns that AI is competing for electricity. This means expectations for BTC’s future direction have become less clear—neither bullish nor bearish, people just want to protect their capital. For BTC, sentiment could remain under pressure in the short term. Although a large number of put options have been purchased, the options market is never 100% accurate. 💡 This means BTC could continue trading in the $82,000–$84,000 range in the short term. title: 山寨季是怎么轮动的？为什么你的币总是最后一个涨
subTitle:
很多人难受的点：BTC涨的时候我的山寨不动，山寨起飞的时候我又没在
车上。其实山寨轮动是有大致剧本的。

【经典顺序】BTC先动（吸走注意力）→ 资金外溢到ETH和大主流 →
再扩散到板块龙头 → 最后扫到各种小币杂毛 → 全场普涨过热，行情
接近尾声。你总感觉自己的币最后涨，因为你买的位置往往就在轮动
链条的末端。

【两个实用观察】1. BTC占比（BTC.D）下降，通常说明资金在往山寨流，
山寨季启动的信号之一；2. 山寨普涨但BTC滞涨，往往是行情进入尾声
的信号，这时候追高杂毛币，接盘概率最大。

【结论】轮动不是平均主义，不是每个山寨都会涨。有叙事、有真实
流通量、有板块地位的才轮得到。与其猜哪个百倍币，不如盯紧资金
现在在哪、下一站可能去哪。

你怎么看？评论区聊聊你的经历。

is nearing its end. You always feel like your coin is the last to rise, because you often buy right at the end of the rotation

title: 滚仓：富贵险中求，还是爆仓加速器？
subTitle:
滚仓这个词最近很火，故事都一样：小本金几倍杠杆吃大趋势，滚动几次
翻几十倍。今天讲讲它没告诉你的部分。

【滚仓在干什么】浮盈不再落袋，而是当成新仓位的风险金继续开仓，
相当于拿市场的钱加杠杆。趋势不停，复利惊人；趋势一停，从浮盈
几十个点到归零，也就一两根大阴线的事。

【数学真相】滚仓的本质是「连续押对」。假设每次胜率60%，连对四次
的概率只有13%。你看到的一夜翻倍帖，背后是99个已经删号的人。
幸存者偏差是这个行业最贵的东西。

【如果你一定要试】1. 只用你亏光了也不心疼的那部分钱；2. 浮盈滚动
到一定倍数，强制抽出本金，用「市场的钱」继续滚；3. 提前写好清零
预案。滚仓是烟花，不是过日子。别拿过日子的钱，放烟花。

translatedData.subTitle:
“Compounding positions” has been all the rage lately, and the stories are always the same: use a small amount of capital and several times leverage to ride a major trend, then compound a few times
and multiply your money dozens of times over. Today, let’s talk about what those stories leave out.

【What Compounding Positions Involves】Instead of cashing out unrealized gains, you use them as risk capital for new positions, continuing to open trades,
It’s like using the market’s money to leverage up. As long as the trend continues, compounding can be astonishing; once it stops, unrealized gains can
go from tens of points to zero in just one or two big bearish candles.

【The Math】The essence of compounding positions is “getting it right consecutively.” If you have a 60% win rate each time, the odds of getting it right four times in a row
are only 13%. Behind every post about doubling your money overnight are 99 people who have already deleted their accounts.

Seven iron rules to remember if you like short-term trading:
1. Fast rise, slow pullback—often a sign of accumulation
When the market shoots up and then moves sideways or pulls back slightly, don’t rush to sell. It could be major players quietly rebuilding their positions.
Often, this kind of price action is followed by new highs. The key is to see whether there’s heavy selling volume during the pullback.
2. Sharp drop, slow recovery—watch out for distribution
If you see the price flash-crash and then slowly climb back up, don’t mistake it for a buying opportunity.
This pattern often means the market makers are gradually exiting without drawing attention. Chasing the price can easily turn you into the one left holding the bag.
3. Heavy volume at the highs isn’t an immediate sell signal; a low-volume rally is more dangerous
Heavy volume means trading activity is strong and money is still competing to buy;
but if volume starts shrinking after that and the price keeps rising, be alert—the rally may already be losing steam.
4. Don’t rush in on heavy volume at the bottom—look for follow-through
Many people rush in as soon as they see heavy volume at the bottom, only to fall for a “one-volume fakeout.”
Real opportunities come with sustained high volume. Stable high volume for three days or more is what shows that the market has found its footing.
5. Price reflects sentiment; volume shows conviction
Sentiment drives volatility, but trading volume reflects what the money is doing.
You’re betting on consensus expectations, and rising volume brings greater conviction. Watch the strength of sentiment and the direction of volume instead of guessing where the top or bottom is.
6. Don’t focus on who knows the most; focus on who can trade the least
Frequent trading is retail investors’ biggest trap. The more you trade, the more anxious you get; the more anxious you get, the more money you lose.
Experts don’t make predictions every day. They stick to their strategy and follow through—even when they’re wrong, they don’t panic.
7. Time is a friend to compounding, not an enemy
Big gains come from explosive moves, but wealth comes from accumulation.
Repeatedly applying one proven method is far better than agonizing every day over “what to buy.”

📰 What is a South Korean bank really up to by offering Bitcoin-backed loans? Is it about regulation or just good business?

Jeonbuk Bank, a commercial bank in South Korea, has started offering Bitcoin-collateralized loans to corporate clients. A third-party custodian is responsible for holding the Bitcoin collateral. According to CoinTelegraph, this is the first time a mainstream bank in South Korea has launched such a product. It signals that traditional finance is beginning to recognize the value of crypto assets, but it’s too early to say whether this is an opportunity or a risk.

Why is this news important?
The underlying reason is that financial institutions around the world are searching for ways to anchor the value of crypto assets, while South Korea has long been a frontline in the regulatory battle. Jeonbuk Bank isn’t alone: recently, South Korea’s KB Kookmin Bank also applied for a Bitcoin trading license, showing that the policy environment is gradually loosening. More importantly, this marks an attempt to transition cryptocurrency from a “speculative product” to an “asset class.” Banks are willing to recognize its store-of-value function within a compliant framework—a far more complex step than simply buying and selling Bitcoin.

What does this mean for the market?
In the short term, it could boost market sentiment, as it signals formal acceptance of cryptocurrency by the traditional financial system, particularly benefiting South Korea’s domestic crypto market. In the long term, if this model is replicated in Europe and the U.S., it could significantly lower the barriers to institutional investment—but only if regulation keeps pace. There are few historical examples to draw on, but before its collapse in 2008, Lehman Brothers also introduced similar asset-securitization innovations. We all know how that turned out.

这件事根本原因在于全球金融机构正在寻找加密资产的价值锚点，而韩国市场一直是监管博弈的前沿阵地。Jeonbuk Bank此举并非孤例，近期韩国KB Kookmin Bank也申请了比特币交易许可，显示政策环境正在逐步松绑。更重要的是，这标志着加密货币从"投机品"向"资产类"的过渡尝试——银行愿意在合规框架内承认其价值储存功能，这比单纯买卖比特币要复杂得多。

对市场意味着什么？短期看会提振市场情绪，因为这是传统金融体系对加密货币的正式接纳信号，尤其利好韩国本土加密市场。长期看，如果模式被复制到欧美，将极大降低机构资金配置门槛，但前提是监管能跟上。历史参考案例不多，但2008年Lehman Brothers破产前也曾推出过类似资产证券化创新，结果大家都懂。

Moving averages on the daily chart are levels many medium- and long-term investors watch, but first, let’s understand what they are.
Moving above or below a moving average means the price has crossed it; this is not the same as a golden cross or a death cross. A golden cross generally refers to a short-term moving average crossing above a long-term one—for example, MA50 crossing above MA200. A death cross is the opposite.
A price moving back above a long-term moving average is often seen as a sign that the trend is improving, while a break below it is often seen as a sign of weakening. However, a single crossover is far from conclusive.
All data only describes past price movements; prices can move in the opposite direction at any time.

Moving averages are calculated from past prices, so they inherently lag: the longer the period, the smoother the moving average and the slower it is to turn.

title: 金字塔加仓：趋势单怎么越涨越加才不翻车
subTitle:
看对了趋势想加仓，怎么加？一上来就重仓+浮盈加满，是爆仓名单上的
常客。正确的做法叫金字塔加仓。

【原则】每次加仓的量比上一次少。比如首仓30%，第一次回调确认加20%，
再确认加10%。越往上仓位越轻，成本的重心压在低位，回调时你扛得住。

【反过来为什么危险】倒金字塔（底部轻仓、顶部越加越重）意味着你的
平均成本全在高位，稍微一回撤就由赚转亏，心态一崩，操作全变形。
很多人不是看错方向亏的钱，是加仓加错了顺序亏的钱。

【三条铁规矩】1. 只在盈利的单上加仓，亏损的单只减不加（不摊平！）；
2. 每加一次，整体止损位同步上移；3. 加仓前问自己：如果这是全新的一
笔钱，我现在还愿意在这个价位开仓吗？答案犹豫，就别加。

你怎么看？评论区聊聊你的经历。

translatedData.title: Pyramid Scaling: How to Add to a Winning Trend Trade Without Wiping Out
translatedData.subTitle:
If you’ve read the trend correctly and want to add to your position, how should you do it? Going all in from the start and adding everything on top of your unrealized gains is a surefire way to end up on the liquidation list.
A common occurrence. The right approach is called pyramid scaling.

【Principle】Each time you add to your position, add less than you did the time before. For example, start with 30%, then add 20% after the first confirmed pullback,
After another confirmation, add 10%. The higher the price goes, the smaller your position becomes, keeping your cost basis weighted toward lower levels so you can withstand pullbacks.

【Why the reverse is dangerous】An inverted pyramid (a small position at the bottom, adding more and more at the top) means your
average cost is entirely at higher levels. Even a slight pullback can turn profits into losses; once you panic, your whole strategy falls apart.

title: 2%仓位法则：为什么亏得起才能活得久
subTitle:
今天讲一个被讲烂了但99%的人做不到的规矩：单笔交易的最大亏损，
不要超过总资金的2%。

【算笔账】1万U本金，2%就是单笔最多亏200U。连续错10次，还剩八千，
账户只回撤20%，靠几笔对的单就能回来。反过来，每次梭哈亏30%，
连错三次只剩34%，要翻近2倍才能回本——数学上已经基本判死刑了。

【怎么落地】不是「仓位不超过2%」，是「这笔单打到止损位时亏的钱
不超过2%」。所以正确顺序是：找止损位 → 算止损距离 → 反推仓位。
止损远的单仓位小，止损近的单仓位可以适当放大。

【为什么难】因为2%赚得太慢，人性嫌它不够刺激。但市场淘汰的从来
不是赚得慢的人，是亏得快的人。先做到不爆仓，再谈翻倍。

translatedData.title: The 2% Position Sizing Rule: Why You Need to Be Able to Take Losses to Last
translatedData.subTitle:
Today, let’s talk about a rule that’s been discussed to death but that 99% of people can’t follow: the maximum loss on a single trade
should not exceed 2% of your total capital.

【Let’s run the numbers】With $10,000 in starting capital, 2% means you can lose at most $200 on a single trade. After 10 losses in a row, you’d still have $8,000,
Your account is only down 20%—a few winning trades can get you back. By contrast, if you go all in and lose 30% each time,
three losses in a row leave you with just 34%. You’d need to nearly double your money to break even—mathematically, you’re pretty much finished.

【How to apply it】It’s not “keep your position size under 2%.” It’s “when this trade hits its stop-loss, the amount you lose
must not exceed 2%.” So the right order is: find the stop-loss level → calculate the stop-loss distance → work backward to determine your position size.

title: 84K修复盘，成本漂移会把盈利磨薄
subTitle:
84K修复盘，成本漂移会把盈利磨薄

午后 BTC 重新摸到 84K 附近，ETH、SOL 也在跟着修复。很多人这时候第一反应是看方向：是不是站稳了、是不是要追、是不是还能再走一段。

但交易里有一种更隐蔽的亏法，不是你看错方向，而是你下单前以为自己面对的是一个价格，真正成交时却面对了另一套订单环境。

这就是成本漂移。

它不像一根大阴线那么显眼，也不像爆仓截图那么刺激。它通常藏在几个细节里：点差突然变宽，盘口第一层挂单不够厚，报价刷新慢半拍，触发条件不同步，手续费和资金成本叠上去以后，原本看起来还不错的一笔单，最后只剩下很薄的风险缓冲。

修复盘最容易让人低估这一点。价格从 82K 一路回到 84K，K 线看上去恢复了，但订单环境不一定恢复。流动性可能还分散在不同交易场所，深度也可能集中在少数报价层，热门交易对看起来很热闹，真正能承接你这一笔数量的位置却未必舒服。

很多交易者复盘时只会问：方向有没有看错？

更该问的是：这笔单在按下之前，有没有先看它会吃到哪一层报价？预估成交价和实际成交价之间会不会拉开？如果行情突然加速，退出时的承接会不会比进入时更差？同样的图，在不同路径里会不会变成完全不同的成交结果？

这几个问题，比“现在涨不涨”更接近真实盈亏。

因为图表只告诉你价格走到哪里，订单环境才告诉你这笔交易会以什么成本进入、以什么条件退出、遇到波动时还剩多少缓冲。尤其在 84K 这种修复但仍有分歧的位置，流动性并不总是均匀分布。你看到的是同一个 BTC，成交时面对的却可能是不同的报价层、不同的深度、不同的触发规则和不同的实际成本。

我更倾向于把每一笔合约交易拆成两步看：

第一步，先判断方向和交易理由。

第二步，再判断这笔单的订单环境是否配得上这个理由。

如果第二步没过，方向再顺也会变得别扭。因为你不是在理想价格上交易，而是在点差、深度、费用、规则和报价刷新速度共同构成的现实里交易。成本漂移一旦发生，最先被吃掉的往往不是本金，而是你原本以为足够的安全边际。

这也是为什么我一直认为，合约交易不能只看图。修复盘里，真正值得比较的不是谁的按钮更顺手，而是哪条执行路径能让成交偏差更小、报价层更清楚、费用和规则更可预期。

PerpEX 这类执行比较视角的价值，就在这里：先选资产，再看不同交易场所的报价层、深度、费用和触发条件，最后再决定这一单从哪里走。它不是替你判断方向，而是提醒你别把方向判断和执行质量混成一件事。

84K 修复盘里，追不追不是唯一问题。

更关键的问题是：如果你真的要做这一笔，成本会不会在成交过程中慢慢漂走。

translatedData.subTitle:
84K rebound session: cost drift can eat away at your profits

In the afternoon, BTC climbed back toward 84K, with ETH and SOL also recovering. At this point, many people’s first thought is to focus on direction: has it found support, should they chase the move, and is there still room to run?

But there’s a more subtle way to lose money in trading: it’s not that you got the direction wrong, but that before placing your order, you thought you were facing one price, while by the time it was filled, you were dealing with a completely different order-book environment.

That’s cost drift.

It’s not as obvious as a huge bearish candle, or as dramatic as a liquidation screenshot. It usually hides in a few details: spreads suddenly widen, there isn’t enough depth at the top of the order book, quotes refresh a beat too slowly, trigger conditions fall out of sync, and fees and funding costs pile up. By the time it’s all added together, a trade that initially looked pretty good may be left with only a thin risk buffer.

subTitle:
📌 一句话总结：上期唯一的胜负手——周线 $82,500 头肩底颈线——守住了，日线转入"修复后的区间震荡"；但涨的是空头被动平仓，不是新增资金。定性：向下有成本带托底，向上缺增量燃料。

- $BTC ~$83,540–83,720｜24h 🔴 +0.65%+0.93%｜7d 🟢 -1.8%-3.5%｜24h 区间 $82,735–84,072

- 恐慌贪婪 61（贪婪）｜全市场市值 ~$2.81–2.89 万亿
🔥 今日 10 条要点
1｜周线颈线保卫战，多头赢了第一回合

👉 但：守住 ≠ 走强。下一道硬门槛 $84,400–84,500，日线收盘有效突破才打开 $86,500–87,000。
2｜⚠️ 关键修正：这波上涨是"空头挤压"
价涨 + OI 下降（BTC -1.9%/ETH -3.1%）+ 空头爆仓主导 = 教科书式 squeeze。
👉 向下燃料确实少了（深跌概率下降），但上涨由强制平仓驱动、缺真实增量资金，挤压一结束就容易回落。这是本期不上修"偏多"的核心依据。若冲到 $85,000，上方还有近 $33 亿空头燃料。
3｜ETF 单周失血 >6.79 亿、ETH -6.97 亿）；SOL ETF 结束 14 周连续流入、转为连续 5 日净赎回。反例：XRP ETF 连 13 周净流入（累计 $18.1 亿）。
👉 这是"守住颈线却涨不动"的直接解释：边际买家上周做了最强的一段撤离，且是全品类降风险，不是单币轮动。盯 10/9 转正（+$2,110 万）能否延续。
4｜链上：真锚是成本带，不是巨鲸动向
72h 巨鲸买入约 15,000 BTC / 166,000 ETH / 4,500 万 XRP；MARA 卖 996 BTC 偿债（是还债不是看空）。
👉 $80,000（STH 支撑）+ $80,500（全市场加权成本线）重叠成"新买家盈亏平衡带"，是下方最强缓冲；CryptoQuant 给的下行参考位 $74,500（条件式，非预测）。
5｜财库"无限承接盘"神话被证伪
Strategy 第 117 次买入仅 334 BTC（持仓 848,000 枚）；主力融资工具 STRC 优先股跌破 $100 面值，触发内部 Buyback Zone，该渠道本周买入 0 BTC，同期回购 STRC 花了 $1.763 亿（约买币金额的 6 倍）。Strive 的 SATA 同样停摆。
👉 Q3 募资 $54.1 亿中仅 9.5% 直接买币——募资 ≠ 买币。恢复信号：STRC/SATA 重回 $100 上方。
6｜$ETH 的"边际买家倒计时"
BitMine 持仓 6,016,414 ETH（约供应 4.9%），距自设 5% 硬顶仅 ~10 万枚，按当前节奏 6–7 周后停买（每周约 1.5 万枚需求消失）；87% 已质押。Tom Lee 重申年末 >$5,000，Citi 给 $3,028。
👉 短期缺边际买盘（偏空）、长期有质押收益与 ETF 回流弹性（中性偏多）。
7｜承接盘的对冲：不是所有机构都在卖
Fidelity 的 FBTC 过去 20 个交易日净买 $3.541 亿 BTC；Morgan Stanley 的 MSBT 本周增持 92 BTC 至 10,639 枚。
👉 流出是净额、内部有分化，大型配置盘在低位逆势承接，流出更可能来自基差/费率套利平仓而非方向性看空。历史经验：ETF 流出常先于 BTC 局部底部形成。
8｜宏观：三层结构，利率松、美元油紧
股债金齐暖——S&P 7,811.54（史上次高）、纳指四周连涨、10Y ~5.23% 终结五周连升、COMEX 金 +1.43%（月内最大日涨）；但 DXY 连涨四周（21 个月最长）、布油破 $105。
👉 宏观不是单向逆风，也远没转顺风。美联储纪要显示"多数成员认为年内再加息一次合宜"，会议 10/27–28。本周裁判：10/14 20:30（北京）9 月 CPI。

至少一台设备被物理改装，来源锁定东南亚授权经销商 CryptoBilis（已停售）；改装 Nano X 在屏下藏电路板+蜂窝模块，截取初始化助记词并回传。损失估 $7,200 万–9,450 万（Ledger 未确认），300+ 钱包被清空，Tether 冻结约 $1,000 万 USDT。

10｜本周三重压力叠加
① 10/16 Deribit 期权到期：BTC $12.5 亿 + ETH $2.475 亿；② 10/12 APT 解锁 1,131 万枚、10/15 ARB 解锁 9,265 万枚（~$1,750 万）；③ IMF-世行年会 10/12–18（曼谷）。另有泰国现货 BTC/ETH ETF 框架 10/16 生效。
👉 CPI + 到期 + 解锁，本周中后段波动放大。

translatedData.content:
🐋 $ETH  has moved above the daily MA50 (2557.74).
Many medium- and long-term investors keep an eye on this moving average, so let’s first understand how it’s calculated.
A “golden cross” or “death cross” generally refers to the daily MA50 crossing the MA200: when the MA50 crosses above the MA200, it’s called a golden cross; when it crosses below, it’s called a death cross. These are crossings between two moving averages, which are different from the price crossing a moving average.
A moving average is simply a line calculated from average prices. It has no magic of its own; much of its significance comes from the fact that many people watch it.
With leveraged trading, first consider whether you can handle the worst-case scenario, then think about what the indicators are saying.

title: 分批止盈：落袋为安和让利润奔跑，怎么兼得
subTitle:
止盈比止损难，因为止损砍的是恐惧，止盈砍的是贪婪。行情越好你越不想
卖，一回调又后悔没跑。分享我一直在用的分批止盈。

【三段式】第一段：到第一个目标位（比如1倍盈亏比）减仓1/3，先落袋，
这时候这笔单已经不会亏了，心态立刻不一样。第二段：到第二目标位
（比如2倍盈亏比）再减1/3。第三段：剩下的用移动止损跟，跌破均线
或前低就走，让利润自己跑。

【为什么这样】全仓跑早了会拍大腿，全仓拿着经常坐电梯回到解放前。
分批的本质是把「卖在最高点」这个不可能任务，拆成三笔还不错的决策。

【关键动作】减仓之后把止损上移到成本价，这就是传说中的「免费单」。
手里的利润单，最怕的就是抱着抱着变成亏损单。

translatedData.title: Scaling Out: How to Lock In Profits While Letting Them Run
translatedData.subTitle:
Taking profits is harder than cutting losses, because cutting losses means overcoming fear, while taking profits means overcoming greed. The better the market is doing, the less you want to
sell—then when it pulls back, you regret not getting out. Here's the scale-out strategy I've been using.

【Three stages】Stage 1: When the price reaches the first target (for example, a 1:1 risk-reward ratio), sell 1/3 of your position to lock in some profits,
At this point, the trade can no longer lose money, and your mindset immediately changes. Stage 2: When the price reaches the second target,
(for example, a 2:1 risk-reward ratio), sell another 1/3. Stage 3: Let a trailing stop manage the rest; exit if the price falls below the moving average
or the previous low, and let your profits run. 

【Why this works】If you sell your entire position too early, you'll kick yourself. If you hold the whole position, you often end up riding the elevator back down to where you started.

To see which side the big money is on, many people look at the long/short ratio—but the two metrics use completely different calculation methods.
In the all-account long/short ratio, an account with a tiny position counts just as much as one with a huge position, so it more closely reflects the crowd’s sentiment.
The long/short ratio only covers futures positions; spot buying and selling aren’t included, so take its implications for the overall market with a grain of salt.
Calculating your order size based on where you place your stop-loss is much more reliable than picking a position size on a whim.

How can you get scammed just by signing something when it doesn’t cost any Gas? Many people can’t explain it!
This type of signature isn’t recorded on-chain, so you don’t need Gas to sign. But the party who obtains your signature can submit it on-chain to activate the authorization.
An offline signature leaves no on-chain record until it’s submitted, so authorization-checking tools can’t detect it either.
Understanding the rules helps you make more informed decisions; it’s not about predicting whether prices will rise or fall.

Evernorth, a hybrid company focused on healthcare and technology, is preparing to launch its IPO on Nasdaq on Monday, with nearly 473 million XRP as reserve assets. They just merged with Armada Acquisition Corp. II on October 9, originally planned to list on November 12, but the date has been moved up to October 12. The stock ticker is XRPN. They raised about $300 million for the merger, and the CEO said the money will be used to invest in the XRP ecosystem, while also finding ways to keep increasing the amount of XRP they hold.

Why is this news important?
Evernorth’s listing has a special feature: they do not plan to simply sell off all 473 million XRP they hold. Instead, they are preparing some kind of restriction—possibly only being able to use this XRP once the stock price reaches a certain level. There are at least two reasons for this. First, to avoid a large XRP sell-off on IPO day causing stock price volatility. Second, to signal their long-term confidence in XRP and their willingness to be a long-term shareholder. This kind of move is not unusual in the crypto space, but Evernorth is forcing together healthcare, technology, and XRP, possibly to prove that XRP is not just a speculative asset, but one that can fit into a traditional industry ecosystem.

Impact on the market

金融稳定委员会（FSB）主席安德鲁·贝利表示，跨境稳定币的监管和危机管理机制仍不完善，只有28个司法管辖区中的11个完成了相关法规。FSB警告，稳定币挤兑可能通过抛售储备资产和银行存款的方式蔓延至传统金融市场。这表明全球在数字货币监管方面存在巨大短板，而AI带来的网络安全风险可能进一步加剧这一状况。

为什么这条新闻重要？
FSB的警告意味着监管真空可能让大规模稳定币风险爆发。根本原因是各国有自己的监管步调，缺乏统一标准。这与近期加密市场波动密切相关，11个完成框架的辖区比例极低（不到40%），意味着大多数地区仍允许高风险操作。这解释了为何像TerraUSD那样的问题能引发连锁反应——监管滞后导致市场没有安全网。

对市场的影响
对BTC/ETH的影响更多体现在情绪层面。目前$84,238.01的BTC和$2,572.68的ETH显示出市场对系统性风险的消化能力，但FSB的警告可能让投资者重新评估加密资产的稳定性。长期来看，监管完善会提振信心，但短期内可能增加波动性。历史案例如2013年银行挤兑显示，缺乏预案的危机会摧毁信任。

操作思路
💡 看中性偏空，建议关注$84,238.01的BTC心理防线。如果监管进展落后预期（比如G20峰会未能推出统一框架），这个判断作废。

Why can the same smart contract code be deployed directly to several different chains?
The EVM is a stack-based virtual machine. Each data unit (word) is 256 bits, and the stack has a maximum depth of 1024.
Here’s the key point: when operating across different EVM-compatible chains, addresses may look the same, but you need to know which chain holds the assets.
When you call a contract on Ethereum, the EVM charges Gas for each instruction it executes, paid in $ETH . The current price is 2572.97.
Understanding the principles can help you avoid pitfalls, but it can’t replace risk management.

title: 滚仓：富贵险中求，还是爆仓加速器？
subTitle:
滚仓这个词最近很火，故事都一样：小本金几倍杠杆吃大趋势，滚动几次
翻几十倍。今天讲讲它没告诉你的部分。

【滚仓在干什么】浮盈不再落袋，而是当成新仓位的风险金继续开仓，
相当于拿市场的钱加杠杆。趋势不停，复利惊人；趋势一停，从浮盈
几十个点到归零，也就一两根大阴线的事。

【数学真相】滚仓的本质是「连续押对」。假设每次胜率60%，连对四次
的概率只有13%。你看到的一夜翻倍帖，背后是99个已经删号的人。
幸存者偏差是这个行业最贵的东西。

【如果你一定要试】1. 只用你亏光了也不心疼的那部分钱；2. 浮盈滚动
到一定倍数，强制抽出本金，用「市场的钱」继续滚；3. 提前写好清零
预案。滚仓是烟花，不是过日子。别拿过日子的钱，放烟花。

translatedData.title: Rolling Positions: Fortune Through Risk, or an Accelerator to Liquidation?
translatedData.subTitle:
“Rolling positions” has been all the rage lately, and the stories are always the same: use a small amount of capital and several times leverage to ride a major trend, then roll it over a few times
and turn it into dozens of times your original stake. Today, let’s talk about what they don’t tell you.

【What Rolling Positions Involves】Instead of cashing out unrealized gains, you use them as risk capital for new positions,
It’s essentially using the market’s money to add leverage. As long as the trend continues, compounding can be astonishing; once it stops, unrealized gains can go
from dozens of points to zero in just one or two huge bearish candles.

【The Math】The essence of rolling positions is “getting it right repeatedly.” If you have a 60% chance of winning each time, the odds of winning four times in a row
are only 13%. For every post you see about doubling your money overnight, there are 99 people who’ve already deleted their accounts.

China’s A-share market has fallen to 3,700 points. What a mess. They’re convening another emergency economic meeting. Sigh.

But more worrying than the stock market’s decline is the problem with the entire economic cycle.

If the domestic economy is to truly recover, it will probably have to address three things:

First, give money to young people.

Instead of continuing to pour money into low-return infrastructure and redundant construction, directly improve household incomes so young people can afford to spend, feel more secure about their lives, and have the confidence to spend and plan for the future.

Second, properly enforce the Labor Law.

The eight-hour workday, two-day weekends, and overtime pay are all basic rights guaranteed by law.

Without time, workers have no life; without income growth, there is no consumption. When businesses squeeze labor costs to the limit, they ultimately lose consumers too.

Third, ease the burden on small and medium-sized businesses.

Cut taxes, reduce institutional costs, and address the problems of having to pay expenses upfront and of overdue payments, so small and medium-sized businesses have cash flow, make profits, and have room to survive.

If small and medium-sized businesses can’t stay afloat, there will be no jobs. If young people have no jobs or income, there can be no consumer market.

Ultimately, the economy isn’t a machine that can grow automatically just by continually injecting capital.

Businesses need profits, workers need income, and markets need consumption.

These three things must form a virtuous cycle.

The growth model of the past focused more on increasing investment, expanding capacity, and pursuing scale.

But when production capacity keeps growing while household purchasing power fails to keep pace, continuing to expand supply will only intensify competition and thin out profits.

You have to give something up to gain something.

Give up some inefficient investment in exchange for income growth for households; give up some short-term tax revenue in exchange for the survival of small and medium-sized businesses; give up some reliance on low-cost labor in exchange for a healthier consumer market.

大A跌到3700点，真的惨。又在紧急召开经济会议，哎

但比股市下跌更值得担心的，是整个经济循环的问题。

国内经济如果想真正走出来，恐怕绕不开三件事：

第一，给年轻人发钱。

不是继续把钱投向低回报的基建和重复建设，而是直接改善居民收入，让年轻人有消费能力、有生活预期，敢花钱，也敢规划未来。

第二，真正落实劳动法。

八小时工作制、双休、加班费，这些本来就是法律规定的基本权益。

劳动者没有时间，就没有生活；没有收入增长，就没有消费。企业把劳动力成本压到极限，最终也会失去消费者。

第三，给中小企业减负。

减税、降低制度性成本、解决垫资和账款拖欠问题，让中小企业有现金流、有利润、有生存空间。

中小企业活不下去，就没有就业；年轻人没有工作和收入，消费市场就无从谈起。

说到底，经济不是一台只要不断投入资本就能自动增长的机器。

企业需要利润，劳动者需要收入，市场需要消费。

这三者必须形成正向循环。

过去的增长模式，更多是在做大投资、扩大产能、追求规模。

title: 金字塔加仓：趋势单怎么越涨越加才不翻车
subTitle:
看对了趋势想加仓，怎么加？一上来就重仓+浮盈加满，是爆仓名单上的
常客。正确的做法叫金字塔加仓。

【原则】每次加仓的量比上一次少。比如首仓30%，第一次回调确认加20%，
再确认加10%。越往上仓位越轻，成本的重心压在低位，回调时你扛得住。

【反过来为什么危险】倒金字塔（底部轻仓、顶部越加越重）意味着你的
平均成本全在高位，稍微一回撤就由赚转亏，心态一崩，操作全变形。
很多人不是看错方向亏的钱，是加仓加错了顺序亏的钱。

【三条铁规矩】1. 只在盈利的单上加仓，亏损的单只减不加（不摊平！）；
2. 每加一次，整体止损位同步上移；3. 加仓前问自己：如果这是全新的一
笔钱，我现在还愿意在这个价位开仓吗？答案犹豫，就别加。

translatedData.title: Pyramid Adding: How to Add to a Trend Trade as It Rises Without Blowing Up
translatedData.subTitle:
If you’ve correctly identified the trend and want to add to your position, how should you do it? Going in heavy right away and adding until you’re fully loaded with unrealized gains is a recipe for becoming a
regular on the liquidation list. The right approach is called pyramid adding.

【Principle】Add less each time than you did the time before. For example, start with 30%, then add 20% after the first confirmed pullback,
After another confirmation, add 10%. The higher the price goes, the smaller your position becomes, keeping the bulk of your cost basis low so you can withstand a pullback.

【Why the reverse is dangerous】An inverted pyramid (a small position at the bottom, adding more and more near the top) means your
average cost is concentrated at the highs. Even a slight pullback can turn profits into losses. Once you lose your nerve, your whole trading plan falls apart.

U.S. spot $ETH  ETFs saw net outflows of $542.1 million last week (according to SoSoValue data compiled by The Block), their worst week since January. Since September 29, funds have seen net redemptions for nine consecutive trading days, totaling $697.2 million. BlackRock’s ETHA alone accounted for $477 million—nearly 90% of the total. In the same week, $BTC  ETFs saw $681.1 million in outflows, their biggest since June, while $SOL  ETFs ended a 14-week streak of inflows with $24.8 million in outflows. The three major spot ETFs collectively shed around $1.25 billion in a single week—a remarkably synchronized institutional deleveraging.

But the market hasn’t broken down: $ETH  is currently trading around $2,570, holding above the psychological $2,500 level and closing above its 50-week moving average for the fourth consecutive week. The $2,520 neckline of the “Adam and Eve” double bottom has become the short-term dividing line between bulls and bears.

More interesting is the opposing position: a whale has opened a $50 million long position with 25x leverage, while $ETH  long positions on Bitfinex have surged 266% to their highest level since 2022. Sentiment in the derivatives market is actually shifting more bullish. There are concerns, too: a wallet linked to the Ethereum Foundation just transferred 4,393 $ETH (about $11.13 million) to Kraken. Exchange balances have climbed to 14.9 million ETH, a one-month high, meaning potential selling pressure has not gone away.

My take: this isn’t simply a bearish story—institutional money is cooling off through ETF channels, while on-chain whales and highly leveraged funds are adding to long positions early. The ultimate verdict on this divergence will come from the U.S. CPI report tomorrow evening Beijing time. If inflation comes in below expectations, the nine-day outflow streak could end and spark a rebound; if it comes in above expectations, crowded long positions could instead trigger a long squeeze. U.S. CPI Hasn’t Been Released Yet｜For ETH, Watch How Rate Expectations Feed Through｜Light Position Around $2,520 While Waiting for Confirmation

My stance is to wait for the data, not bet on a one-way move before its release. The U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics’ schedule shows that the September Consumer Price Index is due at 8:30 a.m. Eastern Time on October 14, or 8:30 p.m. Beijing Time that day. The Fed’s website lists its next regular policy meeting for October 27–28. These are scheduling facts—not inflation results, and certainly not a decision to raise or cut rates. If someone on social media claims that “official CPI is already out” or “the Fed has already pivoted,” I’ll first check the original release page and meeting statement.

Why focus on ETH rather than just discussing macro? ETH is priced as a risk asset, serves as collateral for on-chain applications, and carries a staking-yield narrative. If inflation comes in above expectations and pushes up interest rates and the dollar, risk-asset valuations and the cost of leveraged capital could come under pressure. A lower-than-expected reading could prompt the opposite expectations. But prices don’t move on a single number alone: core components, revisions to prior readings, bond yields, and what the market had already priced in all matter. Staking rewards are denominated in ETH, which does not mean they can automatically offset fluctuations in ETH’s spot price in dollar terms. Recent information—from weak fund flows to listed companies adding to their holdings—points in different directions, so no single news item can replace an assessment of the macro scenarios.

How has the market reacted so far? At the time of writing, Kraken ETH/USD was trading around $2,522, below the daily open of $2,534; the intraday high was about $2,577 and the low about $2,501. This is price action that occurred before the data release; it should not be described as the market having already traded on September CPI, which has not yet been published. For now, I’m treating the area around $2,500 as a short-term support zone to watch, while $2,577 is the intraday high that ETH needs to reclaim. If $2,500 breaks and the rebound is weak, that invalidates the short-term stabilization view. If ETH holds above $2,577 and BTC stabilizes at the same time, then I’d consider whether the rebound has room to continue. Either way, spreads and slippage may widen suddenly around the release, so preset levels may not match the prices at which trades can actually be executed.

If I were trading this myself, I wouldn’t enter now. I’d only consider a small spot long, with no high leverage. The trigger would be an ETH four-hour close above $2,577, followed by a retest that holds, while Treasury yields do not spike sharply in the opposite direction after the data release. Only then would I enter with at most 2% of my total capital. I’d take half off at the first target of $2,630, reduce again at the second target of $2,680, and manage the remainder with a trailing take-profit. If ETH falls back below $2,530 after entry and fails to recover, I’d reduce the position first; the hard stop would be below $2,490. If CPI and the rate market’s reaction conflict, prices gap sharply on the order book, or BTC breaks down, I’d cancel the plan and close any remaining position. If the conditions aren’t met, I’ll stay out of the market—I won’t describe watching as having traded.

Sources: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics 2026 release schedule; Federal Reserve FOMC meeting calendar; live Kraken ETH/USD quote. #ETH
This is solely my personal market observation and does not constitute investment advice.

市场已经如何反应？写稿时 Kraken ETH/USD 最近成交约2522美元，低于日开2534美元；日内高约2577美元、低约2501美元。这是数据发布前的既有波动，不能写成市场已经交易了尚未公布的9月CPI。我先把2500附近视为短线支撑观察区，2577是上方需要重新夺回的日内高点。若2500失守后反抽无力，短线企稳判断就被推翻；若站稳2577并且BTC同步企稳，才考虑反弹有延续空间。无论哪种路径，发布前后的点差和滑点都可能突然扩大，预设价位未必等于实际可成交价。

如果是我自己交易，现在不参与，方向只预备现货轻仓试多，不开高杠杆。触发条件是ETH四小时收盘站上2577，回踩不破，同时数据公布后美债收益率没有逆向急升；满足后才用总资金最多2%入场。第一目标2630减仓一半，第二目标2680再减，余仓以移动止盈处理。若入场后重新跌破2530且无法收复，先缩仓；硬止损设在2490下方。若CPI与利率市场反应相互矛盾、盘口跳价严重或BTC破位，就取消计划并平掉剩余仓位。条件未触发便继续空仓，不把观察说成成交。

Today, the internet, artificial intelligence, blockchain, and global networks are redefining how people collaborate—and new paradigms are naturally redefining “geopolitical boundaries” as well.

When a person’s economic activity can cross national borders, when capital can flow around the globe, when AI can reduce the cost of organization and management, and when digital identities and on-chain assets can move between jurisdictions, traditional states’ control over the boundaries of economic activity, information, and social organization may face new challenges.

With transformative technological innovations like AI, human society in the future may still live across different geographic regions and still need laws, public services, and security. But economic, technological, community, and political identities may no longer need to be tied entirely to the same country.

A person could be a citizen of one country while also participating in the global digital economy, belonging to a transnational network, and co-owning an on-chain autonomous organization.

As technology once again changes the costs and boundaries of collaboration, new forms of social organization become possible.

History is not simply a transition from one system to another. Every technological revolution reopens the same question:

How should humanity organize itself to create, distribute, and protect wealth more effectively?

Today’s geopolitical conflicts—between China and the United States, Russia and Ukraine, and across the Middle East—may all seem profoundly “ugly” in the society of the future. A technological civilization built on AI, blockchain, and commercial spaceflight is breaking the rules of the traditional world.

Whether we acknowledge it or not, an era of unprecedented technological explosion has arrived. Looking at historical cycles, every technological leap has driven the emergence of new forms of organization.

The real competition of the future may no longer be merely between nations, but between different technological systems, forms of organization, and networks of civilizational cooperation.

关于我抱美系大腿，看似亲美，实则曲线救国。

仔细想想，如果未来美股、美债、房地产乃至更多传统金融资产逐步上链，稳定币成为全球金融交易的重要结算工具，那么区块链就不再只是一个炒币市场，而是传统金融的另一套底层运行系统。

美帝要的是全球市场，要的是美元资产的流动性，要的是更多人参与它的金融体系。

但问题来了，资产上链之后，总得有结算工具吧？金融体系扩张之后，总得有人持有底层基础设施吧？

这就有意思了。

美系金融资产负责创造需求，稳定币负责结算，区块链协议负责承载交易。

而早期拿到廉价筹码的人，有机会通过持有这些底层资产，分享金融基础设施扩张带来的收益。

所以，所谓抱美系大腿，未必是政治立场上的亲美，也可能是一种资本配置策略。

美国获得市场和资本流动性，华人投资者获得参与全球金融资产的机会。

不必争论谁赢谁输

当然，前提是你拿住的真的是有价值捕获能力的底层资产，而不是披着美国叙事外衣、最终只给项目方提供退出流动性的空气代币。

如果未来金融资产大规模上链，真正值得研究的，不是谁喊得最响，而是谁掌握结算、流动性、抵押品和交易基础设施。

曲线救国的最高境界，不是改变游戏规则，而是在别人制定的游戏规则里，提前买下收费站。

未来某个时间线里国家这个概念可能会越来越模糊。

人类社会经历了从部落社会、宗教共同体，到封建帝国，再到现代民族国家的演变。

推动这些组织形态发生变化的底层动力，往往不是人类突然改变了观念，而是技术创新改变了生产方式、协作半径与资源分配结构。

回头看，人类历史上许多看似不可撼动的社会结构，都曾经是当时技术条件下最有效的组织形式

About my cozying up to the US-led system: it may look pro-American, but in reality, it’s an indirect way of advancing our own interests.

Think about it carefully: if U.S. stocks, Treasury bonds, real estate, and even more traditional financial assets gradually move on-chain in the future, and stablecoins become an important settlement tool for global financial transactions, then blockchain will no longer be just a crypto-trading market. It will be another underlying operating system for traditional finance.

What the U.S. wants is access to global markets, liquidity for dollar-denominated assets, and more people participating in its financial system.

But here’s the question: once assets move on-chain, there has to be a settlement tool, right? And as the financial system expands, someone has to own the underlying infrastructure, right?

That’s where things get interesting.

U.S.-linked financial assets generate demand, stablecoins handle settlement, and blockchain protocols provide the infrastructure for transactions.

Those who acquired tokens cheaply early on may have a chance to benefit from the expansion of financial infrastructure by holding these underlying assets.

So, what’s described as cozying up to the U.S. doesn’t necessarily mean being pro-American politically. It could also be a capital-allocation strategy.

The U.S. gains markets and capital liquidity, while Chinese-speaking investors gain the opportunity to participate in global financial assets.

There’s no need to argue over who wins or loses.

Of course, that assumes what you’re holding is genuinely an underlying asset capable of capturing value—not a worthless token dressed up in an American narrative that ultimately just provides project insiders with liquidity to exit.

If financial assets move on-chain at scale in the future, what’s truly worth studying isn’t who shouts the loudest, but who controls settlement, liquidity, collateral, and trading infrastructure.

The ultimate form of achieving your goals by an indirect route isn’t changing the rules of the game—it’s buying the tollbooths before anyone else does, within a game whose rules someone else made.

At some point in the future, the very concept of a nation-state may become increasingly blurred.

Human society has evolved from tribal communities and religious communities to feudal empires, and then to modern nation-states.

The underlying forces driving these changes in social organization have often not been sudden shifts in human beliefs, but technological innovations that changed how things were produced, the scale of collaboration, and the structure of resource distribution.

Looking back, many social structures in human history that once seemed unshakable were simply the most effective forms of organization available under the technological conditions of their time.

今天，互联网、人工智能、区块链与全球化网络，正在重新定义人与人之间的协作方式，新的范式自然而然的也会重新定义“地缘政治边界”。

当一个人的经济活动可以跨越国界，当资本可以在全球范围内流动，当 AI 能够降低组织与管理成本，当数字身份和链上资产能够在不同司法辖区之间流通，传统国家对经济、信息与社会组织的边界管理，就可能面临新的挑战。

在Ai这种质变的技术革新下，未来的人类社会，或许依然生活在不同的地理区域，依然需要法律、公共服务与安全保障，但经济身份、技术身份、社群身份和政治身份，未必还需要完全绑定在同一个国家之中。

可以是一个国家的公民，同时是全球数字经济的参与者、某个跨国网络的成员，以及一个链上自治组织的共同所有者。

当技术再次改变协作的成本与边界，新的社会组织形式也就有了诞生的可能。

历史不是简单地从一个制度走向另一个制度，而是每一次技术革命，都在重新回答同一个问题：

人类究竟应该以什么方式组织起来，才能更有效地创造、分配与保护财富？

今天的中美、俄乌、中东等地缘政治斗争，在未来社会里都显得无比“丑陋”，以Ai、区块链、商业航天为基准的技术文明正在打破传统世界的法则。

承认也好、不承认也罢。一个史无前例科技大爆炸的时代，已经降临，从历史周期看，每一次技术跃迁都会推动新的组织形式形成。

未来真正的竞争，或许不再只是国家与国家之间的竞争，而是不同技术体系、组织形式与文明协作网络之间的竞争。

Technical principles | What can account abstraction (ERC-4337) solve?
ERC-4337 implements account abstraction without modifying Ethereum’s consensus rules. Its core contract, EntryPoint, was deployed to the Ethereum mainnet in March 2023.
A smart contract wallet is code itself. Bugs in the code or poorly designed recovery rules can also result in asset losses.
With a Paymaster, you can make Ethereum transactions even if your wallet has no $ETH , with a third party covering the Gas fees.
Don’t invest with borrowed money. The pressure can lead people to make poor decisions.

技术原理｜账户抽象（ERC-4337）能解决什么？
ERC-4337 在不修改以太坊共识规则的前提下实现了账户抽象，核心合约 EntryPoint 在 2023 年 3 月部署到以太坊主网。
智能合约钱包本身也是代码，代码有漏洞或恢复规则设计不当，同样可能造成资产损失。
借助 Paymaster，钱包里没有 $ETH 也可以完成以太坊操作，由第三方垫付 Gas。
不要用借来的钱去投资，压力容易让人做出错误的决定。

There’s no need to argue over who wins or loses.

Of course, that assumes what you’re holding is genuinely an underlying asset capable of capturing value—not a worthless token dressed up in an American narrative that ultimately just provides project insiders with liquidity to exit.

If financial assets move on-chain at scale in the future, what’s truly worth studying isn’t who shouts the loudest, but who controls settlement, liquidity, collateral, and trading infrastructure.

The ultimate form of achieving your goals by an indirect route isn’t changing the rules of the game—it’s buying the tollbooths before anyone else does, within a game whose rules someone else made.

At some point in the future, the very concept of a nation-state may become increasingly blurred.

Human society has evolved from tribal communities and religious communities to feudal empires, and then to modern nation-states.

The underlying forces driving these changes in social organization have often not been sudden shifts in human beliefs, but technological innovations that changed how things were produced, the scale of collaboration, and the structure of resource distribution.

Looking back, many social structures in human history that once seemed unshakable were simply the most effective forms of organization available under the technological conditions of their time.

title: 2%仓位法则：为什么亏得起才能活得久
subTitle:
今天讲一个被讲烂了但99%的人做不到的规矩：单笔交易的最大亏损，
不要超过总资金的2%。

【算笔账】1万U本金，2%就是单笔最多亏200U。连续错10次，还剩八千，
账户只回撤20%，靠几笔对的单就能回来。反过来，每次梭哈亏30%，
连错三次只剩34%，要翻近2倍才能回本——数学上已经基本判死刑了。

【怎么落地】不是「仓位不超过2%」，是「这笔单打到止损位时亏的钱
不超过2%」。所以正确顺序是：找止损位 → 算止损距离 → 反推仓位。
止损远的单仓位小，止损近的单仓位可以适当放大。

【为什么难】因为2%赚得太慢，人性嫌它不够刺激。但市场淘汰的从来
不是赚得慢的人，是亏得快的人。先做到不爆仓，再谈翻倍。

translatedData.title: The 2% Rule: Why You Need to Be Able to Take Losses to Stay in the Game
translatedData.subTitle:
Today, let’s talk about a rule that’s been discussed to death but that 99% of people can’t follow: the maximum loss on a single trade
should be no more than 2% of your total capital.

【Let’s do the math】With 10,000 USDT in starting capital, 2% means losing no more than 200 USDT on a single trade. After 10 consecutive losses, you’d still have 8,000,
If your account is down just 20%, a few winning trades can bring it back. By contrast, if you go all-in and lose 30% each time,
three losses in a row leave you with just 34% of your capital. You’d need to nearly double it to break even—mathematically, you’re almost out of the game.

【How to apply it】It’s not “keep your position size under 2%.” It’s “make sure the amount you lose if this trade hits your stop-loss
is no more than 2%.” So the right order is: find the stop-loss level → calculate the stop-loss distance → work backward to determine your position size.

2026年10月12日，以太坊（ETH）现货价格报2518.63美元，过去24小时下跌约0.89%。日内走势来看，ETH曾短暂冲高至2571美元附近，但未能有效站稳布林带上轨2575美元，随后快速回落至2504美元的日内低点，最终收于2523美元附近。整体呈现冲高回落的震荡走势，多头尝试上攻但遭遇明显抛压。

二、技术指标全面解读

均线系统方面，ETH当前价格已跌破7日均线（2519.93美元）和25日均线（2540.75美元），但仍运行在99日均线（2509.29美元）上方。短期均线向下穿越中期均线，形成死叉信号，表明短期趋势偏弱。指数移动平均线方面，EMA7报2523.40美元，EMA25报2532.34美元，EMA99报2533.79美元，三线高度粘合，暗示市场正处于方向选择的关键节点。

MACD指标方面，DIFF线报负3.76，DEA线报0.78，柱状图为负4.54。MACD柱状图连续为负且绝对值有所收窄，空头动能正在减弱但尚未完全消退。RSI指标方面，RSI6从低点27.55反弹至43.49，RSI12报44.31，RSI24报48.16，短期超卖状态有所修复，但整体仍处于中性偏弱区间。

KDJ指标出现明显的金叉信号，K值从17.69大幅反弹至30.10，D值从23.05升至25.33，J值从6.98飙升至39.63，三线向上发散，为短期反弹提供了技术支撑。威廉指标WR从负86.86回升至负75.02，同样确认了超卖区域的反弹行情。

布林带显示上轨2579.17美元、中轨2541.67美元、下轨2504.17美元，当前价格在中轨与下轨之间运行。带宽持续收窄，ATR指标降至14.95美元，为近期低位，暗示大幅波动可能即将到来。

从机构动向来看，市场呈现明显的分化格局。一方面，Bitmine等机构持续增持以太坊，累计持有量已达到总供应量的约4.9%，同时观察到大量鲸鱼资金从比特币轮动至以太坊，这种机构级别的增持为ETH提供了坚实的中长期支撑。另一方面，美国现货以太坊ETF连续九天净流出，累计流出超过5.42亿美元，创下一月份以来的最差单周表现，反映出部分机构投资者在当前价位选择获利了结。

title: 分批止盈：落袋为安和让利润奔跑，怎么兼得
subTitle:
止盈比止损难，因为止损砍的是恐惧，止盈砍的是贪婪。行情越好你越不想
卖，一回调又后悔没跑。分享我一直在用的分批止盈。

【三段式】第一段：到第一个目标位（比如1倍盈亏比）减仓1/3，先落袋，
这时候这笔单已经不会亏了，心态立刻不一样。第二段：到第二目标位
（比如2倍盈亏比）再减1/3。第三段：剩下的用移动止损跟，跌破均线
或前低就走，让利润自己跑。

【为什么这样】全仓跑早了会拍大腿，全仓拿着经常坐电梯回到解放前。
分批的本质是把「卖在最高点」这个不可能任务，拆成三笔还不错的决策。

【关键动作】减仓之后把止损上移到成本价，这就是传说中的「免费单」。
手里的利润单，最怕的就是抱着抱着变成亏损单。

translatedData.title: Scaling Out of a Position: How to Lock In Profits While Letting Them Run
translatedData.subTitle:
Taking profits is harder than cutting losses, because cutting losses means overcoming fear, while taking profits means overcoming greed. The better the market is doing, the less you want to
sell—and when it pulls back, you regret not getting out. Here's the scaling-out strategy I've been using.

【Three stages】Stage one: when it reaches the first target (for example, a 1:1 risk-reward ratio), reduce your position by 1/3 and lock in some profits,
At this point, the trade can no longer lose, and your mindset immediately changes. Stage two: when it reaches the second target
(for example, a 2:1 risk-reward ratio), sell another 1/3. Stage three: trail the rest with a moving stop-loss; if it falls below the moving average
or the previous low, exit and let the profits run.

【Why this works】If you sell your entire position too early, you'll kick yourself. If you hold the whole position, you often end up right back where you started.

📰 Why Is the Hardware Wallet Crisis Making Multisig More Popular?

Hardware wallet manufacturers and users in Bitcoin and other cryptocurrencies have increasingly faced security issues recently, such as the Coldcard incident. In this situation, hardware wallet sales may rise, and over the long term, users may opt for more expensive but safer setups. In fact, knowledgeable Bitcoin users have been using multisig hardware wallets from multiple brands for a long time. Now, following the Coldcard crisis this summer, this trend is accelerating.

Why does this news matter?
Security challenges facing hardware wallets are pushing the market to look for new solutions. Multisig wallets are inherently more secure because they require signatures from multiple private keys to make a transaction. This means hardware wallet sales may increase in the short term, while in the long run, users may need to prepare more complex wallet setups—creating new opportunities and challenges for both manufacturers and users.

Impact on the market
This news may not directly affect the price of Bitcoin or Ethereum, but increased adoption of multisig wallets could indicate that users are becoming more cautious about security. This could have a positive impact on hardware wallet manufacturers’ revenue and may also improve security across the cryptocurrency market as a whole. Historically, the market has strengthened its security measures after every major security incident.

How to approach it
This suggests that cryptocurrency users are paying more attention to security. The growing adoption of multisig wallets may become a major market trend in the coming years. However, this trend could change if new, more powerful attack methods emerge.

【ETH has fallen by almost half—is this an opportunity or a trap?】

A lot of people see ETH down 49% from its peak and immediately think, “It’s time to buy the dip.” But let me pour a little cold water on that idea: a big drop doesn’t automatically make something a good buy.

I’ve lived through the dot-com bubble, the rise of e-commerce, and several Web3 cycles. I’ve seen too many people get burned by the mindset that “if it’s fallen a lot, it has to go back up.” The key has never been whether the price has hit bottom, but whether the business fundamentals are there.

So, do ETH’s fundamentals stack up right now?

First, let’s look at the flow of funds. The Fear and Greed Index is at 69, meaning market sentiment is still greedy and retail investors are still chasing the market. But BTC’s market dominance has hit a recent high of 59.1%, which means funds are concentrating in the market leaders as a safe haven. The money coming in at this stage is most likely institutions and smart money positioning at lower prices—not retail investors buying the dip.

Now let’s look at the Federal Reserve. The tightening cycle is nearing its end, and U.S. tech stocks have already started pricing that in. If the Fed really does pivot to an accommodative policy, risk assets—including ETH—will benefit. But that’s an expectation, not a fact. If you enter now, you’re betting on the Fed’s policy timeline. Get it right and you could make a lot; get it wrong and you’ll have to ride out the downturn.

In my experience, ETH is now in a deep correction zone and does have long-term value. But until the short-term direction becomes clear, don’t go all in. Buying in stages and managing your position size is the only rational approach.

So here’s the question: are you treating this ETH move as a long-term value investment or a short-term trade? What’s the basis for your view?

【ETH跌了快一半，现在到底是机会还是陷阱？】

很多人看到ETH从高点跌了49%，第一反应是"可以抄底了"。但我想泼盆冷水——跌得多不等于就能买。

我是经历过互联网泡沫、电商崛起、Web3几轮周期的人，见过太多人死在"跌多了就该涨"的思维里。关键从来不是价格到没到低点，是这事儿的商业逻辑到没到位。

那现在ETH的商业逻辑通不通？

先看资金面。恐惧贪婪指数69，市场情绪还是贪婪，说明散户还在追。但BTC市场占比59.1%创阶段新高，意味着资金在集中头部避险。这个阶段进来的钱，大概率是机构和聪明钱在低位布局，不是散户的抄底行为。

再看美联储那边。紧缩周期接近尾声，美股科技股已经开始提前反应。如果后面真的转向宽松，风险资产包括ETH会受益。但这是预期，不是事实。现在进去赌的是美联储的政策节奏，赌对了赚大，赌错了就得扛。

从我的经验看，ETH现在处于深度调整区，确实有长线价值。但短线方向没走出来之前，别重仓梭哈。分批进、控制仓位是唯一理性的做法。

所以问题来了：ETH这波你是当长线价值布局，还是短线博弈？你的判断依据是什么？

title: 止损到底该挂哪？技术位和百分比，我这样选
subTitle:
止损挂在哪儿，比设不设止损更讲究。挂太近天天被扫，挂太远一次亏麻。

【固定百分比法】比如每次亏本金的1%-2%就离场。简单粗暴，适合新手
建立纪律。缺点是不看结构，可能正好挂在别人的止损堆里。

【技术位止损法】挂在结构失效的位置：做多挂关键支撑下方，做空挂
压力位上方。逻辑是——这个位置破了，说明我看错的证据出现了。
配合仓位反推：止损距离大，就把仓位调小，保证单笔亏损还是本金的
1%-2%。这才是「止损位定仓位」的正确顺序。

【我最常用的组合】技术位定方向失效点，仓位保命。两者一合并，你
会发现：止损宽的交易，仓位自然就该小；止损近的交易才能放大点仓位。
顺序千万别反——先定仓位再找止损，是大多数人亏钱的根源。

translatedData.title: Where exactly should you place a stop-loss? Here’s how I choose between technical levels and percentages
translatedData.subTitle:
Where you place your stop-loss matters more than whether you set one. Place it too close and it gets triggered every day; place it too far away and one loss can really hurt.

【Fixed-percentage method】For example, exit whenever you lose 1%–2% of your capital. It’s simple and straightforward, and suitable for beginners
to build discipline. The downside is that it ignores market structure, so your stop could end up right where other people’s stops are clustered.

【Technical-level stop-loss method】Place it where the structure is invalidated: for a long position, below key support; for a short position, place it
above resistance. The logic is—if the price breaks through this level, it’s evidence that I was wrong.
Adjust your position size accordingly: if the stop-loss is far away, reduce your position size to ensure the loss on a single trade is still a percentage of your capital.

title: 资金费率里藏着多空情绪，教你读三种典型状态
subTitle:
上次讲了资金费率的机制，今天讲怎么把它当情绪温度计用。

【状态一：费率持续高正】说明多头拥挤，大家都借钱做多。这时候行情
往往在加速赶顶阶段，随时可能来一次「多杀多」的急跌。不是让你立刻
做空，而是：这个阶段追多要格外小心，止损要收紧。

【状态二：费率持续负】空头拥挤。极端负费率经常出现在恐慌底部附近，
因为该跑的都跑了还在做空。历史上不少大反弹就起点在这种时候。

【状态三：费率在零附近晃】多空平衡，市场在等方向。这种时候趋势
策略最好歇着，区间思路或观望更合适。

【提醒】费率是温度计，不是方向盘。它告诉你现在谁挤，不告诉你下一
根K线涨跌。把它和你的技术面信号叠着看，别单独当买卖依据。

【State 1: Persistently High Positive Funding Rates】This means longs are crowded, with everyone borrowing to go long. At this point, the market
is often accelerating toward a top, and a sharp “long squeeze” could happen at any moment. I’m not telling you to immediately
short right away; rather, at this stage, be extra cautious about chasing longs and keep your stop-loss tight.

【State 2: Persistently Negative Funding Rates】Shorts are crowded. Extremely negative funding rates often appear near panic-driven bottoms,
because everyone who was going to exit has already done so, yet people are still shorting. Many major rallies in history began at times like this.

So rather than calling it a “breakout,” I’d say the market is testing whether it can hold the psychological 2,500 level.

My personal view is cautious. This level looks more like an area to watch during a pullback than the start of a new rally. I have two reasons. First, 24-hour trading volume was only 0.9 times the average daily volume of the previous 7 days. There was no surge in volume on the way down, but buyers haven’t clearly stepped in either—both sides are waiting and watching. Second, the total crypto market cap fell 3.7% over 24 hours, while $ETH  fell just 0.8%. That’s relatively resilient, but still a long way from showing independent strength.

Where might I be wrong? The daily MA99 is at 2,245, and the current price is still about 12% above it, so the medium-term structure hasn’t actually broken down. An RSI of 43 is also nowhere near an extreme. If volume returns after repeated tests near 2,500, then holding that psychological level could itself become a sentiment turning point—and my caution would prove unnecessary.

The “breakout” in the headline and the “retest” on the chart are two different things. Make sure you understand the direction before drawing conclusions. These are my personal views and do not constitute investment advice.

📰 Why Could New U.S. Accounting Rules Make Direct Redemption Rights for Stablecoins Crucial?

A recent report from Tempo says new accounting standards could make companies more willing to hold stablecoins. The key question is whether stablecoins can be exchanged for cash at any time—that directly determines whether they qualify as “cash equivalents.” This affects how companies account for and invest their funds.

Why does this news matter?
The new rules concern U.S. accounting standard ASC 715, which requires companies to disclose changes in the fair value of financial assets. Tempo found that if stablecoins can be exchanged directly for cash (for example, if Tether can be exchanged directly for U.S. dollars), companies may be more inclined to treat them as cash-management assets rather than ordinary bonds. This means:
- **Underlying reason**: The “cash equivalent” status of stablecoins is crucial for companies and institutions, as it means greater liquidity and a more favorable balance-sheet presentation.
- **Industry context**: Global central banks and regulators are currently at a critical juncture in discussions about stablecoin regulation, and changes to U.S. accounting standards are an important signal.
- **Related events**: Last year, the CFTC approved spot ETFs for USDC and USDT. This accounting-rule change could pave the way for more stablecoins and create policy synergies.

Market impact
If the new rules really make stablecoins more like cash, they could mean:
- **Short term**: Companies may increase their allocations, driving some funds into the stablecoin market and pushing prices higher.
- **Long term**: If stablecoins truly become part of corporate liquidity management, this could further cement their status as “digital dollars” and potentially attract more dollar inflows.
- **Shifting landscape**: Stablecoins with direct exchange channels (such as central bank digital currencies) could benefit, while those that rely on third-party exchanges may face greater pressure.

Possible approach
💡 If the new rules take effect, stablecoins that can be exchanged directly for cash may command a valuation premium. But this depends on companies actually increasing their allocations as a result, rather than the change remaining only a rule on paper. If the Federal Reserve suddenly raises interest rates sharply, causing companies’ borrowing costs to surge, this potential benefit could disappear.

📰 为什么美国会计新规可能让稳定币直接赎回权成为关键？

美国Tempo最近的一份报告说，新会计准则可能让公司更愿意持有稳定币。关键在于，能不能随时用稳定币换现金，这直接决定了它算不算"现金等价物"。这对企业怎么记账、怎么投资都有影响。

为什么这条新闻重要？
这项新规触及的是美国会计准则第715号（ASC 715），它规定企业必须披露金融资产的公允价值变动。Tempo发现，如果稳定币能直接兑换现金（比如Tether可以直接换美元），企业会计上可能会更愿意把这类稳定币当作现金管理，而不是按普通债券来算。这意味着：
- **根本原因**：稳定币的"现金等价物"地位对企业和机构至关重要，它意味着更高的流动性和更好的资产负债表显示。
- **行业位置**：当前正值全球央行和监管机构讨论稳定币监管的关键时期，美国会计准则的调整是重要风向标。
- **关联事件**：去年CFTC批准了USDC和USDT的现货ETF，这次会计准则的变动可能为更多稳定币铺路，形成政策协同效应。

对市场的影响
如果新规真的让稳定币更像现金，可能意味着：
- **短期**：企业会增加配置，带动部分资金流入稳定币市场，推高报价。
- **长期**：如果稳定币真的成为企业流动性管理的一部分，会进一步巩固其作为"数字美元"的地位，可能吸引更多美元入场。
- **格局变化**：对有直接兑换渠道（如中央银行数字货币）的稳定币有利，对依赖第三方兑换的稳定币压力可能更大。

操作思路
💡 新规如果落地，能直接兑换现金的稳定币可能获得估值溢价。但这个判断的前提是，企业真会因此增加配置，而不是仅停留在纸面规则层面。如果美联储突然大幅加息导致企业融资成本飙升，这个利好可能作废。

📰 Why is Bitfinex using Tether’s Hadron to create a fund? What does it mean for the crypto market?

Bitfinex Securities recently tried something new, launching a fund built on Tether’s Hadron protocol. In simple terms, it lets investors use cryptocurrency directly to buy a basket of traditional assets, such as stocks and bonds, without first converting to dollars. This could be good news for people who want exposure to traditional investments through crypto, but want to avoid the hassle or diversify their portfolios.

Why does this matter?
The key is that a crypto protocol is being used to simplify cross-asset investing. Previously, you needed fiat currency to buy into a fund; now, you can participate directly with $ETH or $BTC, lowering the barrier to entry for digital-asset investors. Why is that important? Many institutions are still sitting on the sidelines. If the investment process becomes smoother, they may be more inclined to participate. And by using Tether’s Hadron, Bitfinex is signaling confidence in the potential of cross-chain funds, especially since the Hadron protocol has already gained some recognition.

Market impact
For BTC and ETH, the impact is more likely to be sentiment-driven. In the short term, some existing capital could shift from other crypto projects to Bitfinex, as investors gain a new tool. Over the long term, if this model proves effective at bringing traditional finance and digital assets closer together, it could make regulators more supportive of innovation. Have there been similar developments before? Some, but none on a large scale. BlackRock’s Bitcoin ETF, for example, made a splash, but it doesn’t let investors buy a fund directly with cryptocurrency like this.

Trading outlook
This news is unlikely to have much impact on the broader market, but it is an interesting innovation. If the model proves viable, it could help digitalize the asset industry as a whole. For now, $ETH and $BTC are unlikely to surge or plunge as a result; at most, Bitfinex could see a short-term inflow of funds.

title: Why Does Ethereum Get So Much Attention in November and December?
subTitle:
Have you noticed how many crypto traders start watching Ethereum ($ETH ) closely as the year approaches its final two months?

There is a reason November and December often attract attention in the crypto market. But the real question is: Can Ethereum repeat its previous rallies?

Let's understand the factors behind the year-end narrative.

1. 📈 Historical Market Patterns

Crypto traders often study Ethereum's previous November and December performances to identify recurring trends.

When ETH has delivered strong rallies during past year-end periods, investors naturally become interested in whether similar conditions could develop again.

However, historical performance is not consistent every year. Some year-end periods have been bullish, while others have delivered significant losses.

2. 🟠 Bitcoin Often Sets the Tone

Ethereum doesn't move independently of the broader market.

When Bitcoin ($BTC ) enters a strong uptrend, investor confidence can spread into major altcoins. Ethereum may benefit as traders look for opportunities beyond Bitcoin.

But if BTC weakens, ETH can also face substantial selling pressure.

3. 💰 Liquidity and Investor Sentiment

A strong crypto rally usually needs more than optimism.

Improving liquidity, stronger spot-market demand, institutional participation, and rising investor confidence can all contribute to upward momentum.

If these conditions align toward the end of 2026, Ethereum could benefit. If they don't, the calendar alone will not push prices higher.

4. 🔥 Why Traders Are Watching ETH for Q4 2026

Ethereum remains a major blockchain ecosystem, with activity across DeFi, stablecoins, tokenization, and Layer 2 networks.

These fundamentals help explain why ETH remains on traders' watchlists.

Still, ecosystem growth does not guarantee immediate price appreciation. Market expectations, supply dynamics, and broader economic conditions matter too.

🎯 The Big Question: Can ETH Repeat Its Year-End Rally?

The idea that Ethereum pumps every November and December is too strong. Its historical returns vary considerably depending on the year.

What matters is whether the conditions behind previous rallies return:

- Bitcoin maintains bullish momentum.
- ETH shows strength against BTC.
- Buying demand increases.
- Market liquidity improves.
- Investor sentiment becomes more positive.

If several of these factors align, ETH could have the conditions for another rally.

But if the market weakens, November and December could look very different.

Remember: History can provide context, but it cannot guarantee the future.

💬 What do you think? Will Ethereum deliver a strong finish to 2026, or will this year break the year-end rally narrative?

title: 资金费率是什么？为什么多头要给空头掏钱
subTitle:
玩永续合约绕不开一个词：资金费率。它每8小时结算一次，是多空之间
互相支付的一笔钱，交易所只是代收代付，不赚这个钱。

【机制】永续合约没有交割日，价格怎么和现货保持一致？就靠资金费率：
合约价高于现货价（多头情绪旺）→ 费率为正 → 多头付钱给空头；
合约价低于现货价（空头占优）→ 费率为负 → 空头付钱给多头。
钱在两边倒腾，把合约价格往现货价格上拽。

【代价】别小看这每8小时一笔：年化下来费率高的时候能到百分之几十。
做多时如果一直付高费率，就算方向看对了，利润也会被悄悄磨掉。

【一条实用习惯】开仓前看一眼当前费率。高正费率时追多，你在给空头
打工；极端负费率时追空，同理。费率不是方向指标，但它是成本，成本
影响你这笔交易的性价比。

translatedData.title: What Is the Funding Rate? Why Do Longs Have to Pay Shorts?
translatedData.subTitle:
There’s one term you can’t avoid when trading perpetual contracts: the funding rate. It’s settled every 8 hours and is
a payment exchanged between longs and shorts. The exchange merely collects and distributes it; it doesn’t make money from it.

[Mechanism] Perpetual contracts have no settlement date. So how does their price stay in line with the spot price? The answer is the funding rate:
When the contract price is higher than the spot price (bullish sentiment is strong) → the funding rate is positive → longs pay shorts;
When the contract price is lower than the spot price (bears are in control) → the funding rate is negative → shorts pay longs.
Money flows between the two sides, pulling the contract price toward the spot price.

title: 从保证金提醒到强平，中间发生了什么
subTitle:
强平不是一瞬间的事，它是一个流程。看懂这个流程，你就知道该在哪儿行动。

【第一步】初始保证金：开仓时占用的钱，比如10倍杠杆就是仓位的10%。
【第二步】行情反向走，保证金率上升。App开始弹「保证金不足」提醒，
这时候你还有选择：减仓降杠杆，或者补保证金。
【第三步】维持保证金线：亏损吃穿维持保证金要求，系统开始部分强平，
先平一部分回收风险，而不是一把全平。
【第四步】如果继续恶化，全部强平，你这笔仓位宣告结束。

【重点】从第二步的提醒到第三步的强平，中间是你最后的自救窗口。
但绝大多数人在这个时刻做的不是减仓，而是「再等等」「补点仓摊薄」——
把一个可控的小错误，拖成毁灭性的大错误。记住：提醒弹出来的时候，

translatedData.title: What happens between a margin alert and liquidation?
translatedData.subTitle:
Liquidation doesn’t happen in an instant—it’s a process. Understand how it works, and you’ll know when to act.

[Step 1] Initial margin: The funds tied up when you open a position. For example, with 10x leverage, it’s 10% of the position size.
[Step 2] The market moves against you, and your margin ratio rises. The app starts showing “Insufficient margin” alerts,
At this point, you still have options: reduce your position to lower leverage, or add margin.
[Step 3] Maintenance margin level: Once losses eat into the maintenance margin requirement, the system starts partially liquidating your position,
closing part of it first to reduce risk, rather than closing it all at once.
